text: Program Description Note: This program can prodive scholarship, if you want to get more information, please cantact CUCAS counsellor. Program Selections Students can select from "1+4" preparatory university program. Admitted students will attend Tianjin International Chinese College for one year.Upon completing the coursework and passing HSK level 5, students will have guaranteed transfer to Tijian Polytechnic University. For "1+4”program, students can choose any other majors except for Chinese language major, and they can directly enter their sophomore year with three more years to obtain TJPU'S diploma. Academic Majors Tianjin International Chinese College: Chinese Language Tianjin Polytechnic University: Choose from all undergraduate departments. Graduation and Degree Upon successfully completing the "1+4" preparatory university program,students will be granted a graduation certificate from Tianjin International College, and a Bachelor degree from Tianjin Polytechnic University. Bridge Program Students will study Chinese language at Tianjin International Chinese College and transfer to Tianjin Polytechnic University upon successfully meeting the transfer requirments. Students will obtain undergraduate degree at Tianjin Polytechnic University. Program Tuition
